title: CAN Replay
text: Replay logged CAN messages, 2 outputs; {File name} sets the path and name of MAT-file with messages, {Variable name} sets the variable in MAT-file holding, {Number of times to replay messages} sets the repeat value, {Replay messages to} sets the output location, {Device} sets the cAN device and channel device, {Sample time} sets the block execution rate and {Output as bus} enables signal bus output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: File name
params.values: Path and name of MAT-file with messages untitled.mat (default) | file name

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Variable in MAT-file holding messages ans (default) | variable

params.name: Number of times to replay messages
Replay messages to
params.values: Specify output location CAN Bus (default) | Output port

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN device and channel device list option

params.name: Output as bus
params.values: Enable signal bus output off (default) | on
